description: This file defines the Warehouse class, including its methods, nested classes, and interface implementations, for managing hardware and JSONRPC communication in a plugin architecture.

classes.name: LedInfo
classes.description: A class representing LED information, associated with the Warehouse class, including timing functionality.

classes.name: Warehouse
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing hardware control, device info, and JSONRPC communication, with methods for reset and status management.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Resets the device, optionally suppressing reboot, with a specified reset type.

methods.name: setFrontPanelState
methods.description: Sets the front panel state and updates response.

methods.name: internalReset
methods.description: Performs an internal reset and updates response.

methods.name: lightReset
methods.description: Performs a light reset and updates response.

methods.name: isClean
methods.description: Checks if the device is clean based on age and updates response.

methods.name: executeHardwareTest
methods.description: Executes hardware test, returns success status.

methods.name: dsWareHouseOpnStatusChanged
methods.description: Static callback for warehouse operation status change events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: onSetFrontPanelStateTimer
methods.description: Timer callback for front panel state.

methods.name: processWHResetNoReboot
methods.description: Performs a warehouse reset without reboot.
